letter: Welcome to Peace on the Pond, a private sanctuary designed for restoration, reflection, connection, and renewal. Nestled amid serene natural beauty, our retreat offers a peaceful escape to rejuvenate the spirit and foster meaningful connections.

Thank you for considering us as the setting for your retreat. We are honored by the opportunity to host an intentional, restorative gathering designed to support clarity, reflection, sacred pause, and deep care.

package.name: Sacred Container Signature Package

inclusions: Exclusive use of Peace on the Pond for your retreat dates
Overnight accommodations for up to 12 guests
Use of indoor and outdoor gathering spaces
Access to the labyrinth, trails, lake, and reflection areas
Tea, infused water, fruit, and simple nourishment offerings

payment.balanceLabel: Remaining balance, due 21 days before arrival

terms: All payments made are non-refundable. With written notice at least 120 days before arrival, one courtesy reschedule may be permitted to a future available date within 12 months, subject to availability and current package pricing.
Within 90 days of arrival, payments are non-transferable unless Peace on the Pond is able to rebook the reserved dates.
A standard cleaning and reset fee may apply based on the event's scope, guest count, and use of indoor and outdoor spaces.

Peace on the Pond serves as the venue host and hospitality partner only. LaJuana retains full responsibility for retreat programming, participant screening, facilitation, waivers, insurance, legal compliance, and all experience-related operations.
